C715471.failed_steps: Failed at steps 2 and 3: some documents show a Due Date and a Past Due one day different from before the feature was deployed on staging.
C715471.source: The case, Step 3: "The same documents and the same amounts, shown the same way ... Only the order may differ, and these three changes PRD section 2 lists for this release" — a Date, Due Date and Past Due one day different is not one of them (PRD v13, 13 Nov 2026, What changes for existing users).
observed: SV-12663 is fixed: Past Due now always matches the Due Date shown (checked on every document, screen on Mountain time and on Pakistan time).

Step 2: A/R Detail shows the same documents and amounts, but some Due Dates one day earlier, for example CM2-4357 "Sep 6, 2026" (it was "Sep 7, 2026"). On Pakistan time 16 documents also sit in a different age column.

Step 3: A/R Collection, untouched, as of 11/12/2026, screen on Mountain time: credit memo CM2-4357 (4 Star Truck Repair) shows Due Date "Sep 6, 2026" and Past Due 67. Before the feature it showed Sep 7, 2026 and 66. 74 of 1,457 documents show a different Past Due (150 on Pakistan time).
Cause: the reports now show dates on the calendar day of the location; before the feature they used the UTC (Greenwich) day. Amounts and totals are unchanged.
